headlines.title: High tide flooding closes roads in Corte Madera, Larkspur and Mill Valley
headlines.description: An Oakland police officer fatally shot a man early Monday morning, the department said. Police said the shooting happened along the 400 block of Hegenberger Road, not far from Oakland San Francisco Bay Airport. “Officers responded to community reports of an individual with a firearm,” police wrote in a post on social media. “When officers arrived, they engaged the armed man.” One officer fired their weapon, fatally striking the man, police said. The firearm the man had was determined to be a replica, according to police. The California Department of Justice will lead the investigation, police said. Additional information was not immediately available.
